name: Koaki no Hiyakeato
original_name: こあきの ひやけあと
source:
Ashiya Souma was experiencing something new in his life. Three girls confessed their feelings for him at the same time, and he was asked to choose one of them from the Ladies' Alliance.

Koaki Hameoka is the stepdaughter of his father's second marriage, and they live under one roof.

He gets very excited by girls with suntan marks. She is quite grown up for a girl her age, and the clothes she wears have not kept up with her growth. It's hard to not look at her while at home. 

Kaoki, is also a member of the "Ladies' Alliance", will she make her move even inside the house?

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/firedoor/hiyakeato/page02.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
芦屋相马在他的生活中经历着一些新的事情。三个女孩同时向他表白，他被要求从女子联盟中选择一个。

Koaki Hameoka是父亲第二次婚姻的继女，他们住在同一屋檐下。

他对有晒黑痕迹的女孩感到非常兴奋。对于同龄的女孩来说，她已经长大了不少，穿的衣服也跟不上她的成长。在家的时候很难不看她一眼。

同为“女子联盟”成员的高希，在屋内也会做出举动吗？

[来自[url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/firedoor/hiyakeato/page02.html]官方网站[/url]]
